title: Counting Images and Stops
short: Count pictures by dividing items by items per picture, then stops by dividing pictures by pictures per stop, rounding up each time.
trouble: Forgetting to round up: 52 cards in threes is 17 full pictures plus one more for the last card.

practice.q: A deck in PAO, with 2 pictures on each stop. How many stops?
practice.title: Worked example

blocks.html: Before a run, memory athletes know exactly how many stops they need. The arithmetic is short.
Pictures = items ÷ items per picture (round up). Stops = pictures ÷ pictures per stop (round up).
